text:
elaine: HelixCare signed a 6-month enterprise commit for chat API. We need a capacity plan, cost options, and answers for the vendor security questionnaire (HIPAA scope + SOC2). Legal wants responses within 36h.

jamal: their perf doc: baseline 400 rps, median payload 120 tokens, spikes 1.2k rps for ~20m daily, monthly webinar surge ~8k rps for ~45m. Peak concurrency ~2.5k users. p99 latency target 350ms.

priya: recommendation: rdx-7b-quant for quality; fallback option rdx-3b-quant if cost constraints. Infra sketch: reserve 8 GPUs baseline (covers 400 rps with batching), autoscale to 28 GPUs for 1.2k rps target util ~70%, and a burst pool to 40 GPUs for webinar. Preheat window 60m to warm KV + prefetch. Canary at 5% for 1h.

otto: quick calc for sales (rounded): per-GPU throughput at 120 tokens ~= 60 rps per GPU for rdx-7b-quant with effective batching. So: 400 rps -> ~7 GPUs (round up to 8). 1.2k rps -> ~20 GPUs; we recommend 28 to keep util <75%. 8k rps transient -> with 40 GPUs we can sustain ~2.4k rps, so remainder requires model fallback or regional spillover. Queue policy: 20s soft window then fallback.

priya: autoscale snippet to propose:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 8
  scale_target_utilization: 70
  max_replicas: 40
  burst_policy: "burst_pool"
  preheat_minutes: 60
  canary: {percent: 5, duration_minutes: 60}
  fallback: "rdx-3b-quant"
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: rdx-7b-quant -> 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z routing 5% for 1h. :rocket:

finance-bot: FYI drafting pricing guidance spreadsheet.

jamal: finance needs two quote options: Option A conservative reserve 8 GPUs + burst credits; Option B heavy reserve 20 GPUs to reduce burst burn. Include preheat ops add-on (2 engineer-days per major event). Also add auto-cap alert at 40 GPUs to prevent runaway spend.

finance-bot: drafting numbers: (A) Reserve 8 GPUs monthly -> list cost L1, discount 18% for 6mo commit. Estimated burst credit usage (6 assumed surges/month) -> burn estimate B1. (B) Reserve 20 GPUs -> higher base cost, lower burst usage B2 ~ ~B1/2. Attaching spreadsheet to the quote.

elaine: security Qs: they ask for HIPAA BAA, SOC2 cert date, KMS key rotation policy, HSM integration option, VPC peering steps, and audit log retention of 2 years. @otto please assemble concise responses and attach the ops diagram. Legal wants short, direct answers.

otto: assembling. Minimal ascii diagram below for the onboarding packet:

[HelixCare VPC] -- VPC Peering --> [Redwood Private VPC]
           |                                   |
           +-> PrivateLink (ingress)           +-> KMS (customer-managed or Redwood-managed, HSM on request)

Notes: support customer-managed KMS with key import and rotation; HSM-backed options available. Audit logs delivered to tenant S3 in us-east-1 with 2-year retention. Data residency option: us-east-1 or us-west-2 on request.

priya: preheat runbook highlights: schedule model weight warmup, prime KV prefixes from recent caches, run scripted prompts representing peak paths, validate p99 tail across AZs, and smoke-check QoS metrics. Ops support: 2x on-call for first 72h post-go-live.

jamal: sales wants explicit fallback wording in contract: if >10% projected drop, default to immediate fallback model responses (degraded quality) rather than long queueing. We'll include an impact matrix in appendix showing latency vs. quality tradeoffs.

elaine: good. Keep answers concise. Meeting 14:30 PT today to finalize attachments for legal. I'll create the ticket and link this thread. :white_check_mark:

priya: adding quality-monitor hooks to the rollout: auto-eval on a reserved prompt set and rollback if >5% quality regression.

finance-bot: final: last_message_ts updated.
